content_of_post_to_comment: In a society that is pretty uncomfortable with older people, do you tell people your age? Do you risk hearing "wow, you don't look it, or the silence while they wonder politely how to respond? Or do you keep it to yourself? I can’t decide which one of these is colluding with ageism more; and I want to write an article about it. What do you think?
comment: Maybe the deeper issue isn't disclosure itself but why age becomes a test people feel they must manage. Hiding or revealing both can reinforce the idea that age needs explaining.
